en: The postcard shows a historic, ornate baroque palace with intricate architectural details and a round balcony above a stone terrace. There are symmetrical staircases leading up from both sides and a large arched gated entrance at the bottom, set in a stone foundation with creeping vegetation. The sky is light blue with a few clouds. The text at the top identifies the location as Dornburg an der Saale and names the building as the 'Großherzogliches Schloß', which translates to 'Grand Ducal Palace'.
